learning_outcomes.text: To learn multivariate functions, partial derivatives and multivariate analysis concepts and apply them to engineering problems.
To be able to perform engineering calculations using multiple integrals, line integrals and related mathematical methods.
To be able to model physical and engineering systems using the basic concepts and solution methods of differential equations.
To be able to analyze force, motion, and field problems in mechanical systems using the basic principles of vector analysis.
To be able to develop mathematical modeling, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills to form a basis for mechanical engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: Indefinite integral. Rules for indefinite integration. Substitution method.
Integration by parts method. Integral of rational functions.
Integral of irrational algebraic expressions. Binomial integral. Various substitutions.
Concept of definite integral. Partition of an interval, Riemann sum and definition of definite integral.
Calculation of definite integral using its definition. Proof of basic integration rules.
Fundamental theorems of integral calculus. Substitution method in definite integral.
Integration by parts method in definite integral. Definite integral of some special functions.
Arc length of a curve. Surface area of solids of revolution.
Introduction to multivariate functions. Definition and domain of a multivariate function. Concepts of limit, continuity, and partial derivatives.
